findings.description: Repeated direct Commerce HTTP contract runs in the same external PostgreSQL mode could report UP-TO-DATE and reuse prior XML after the database changed.
findings.resolution: commerce-app/build.gradle disables up-to-date and build-cache reuse whenever JDD_COMMERCE_HTTP_TEST_DB_URL is present. Only the mode flag enters the task fingerprint; H2 mode and all assertions remain intact.
findings.verification: Dedicated jdd_commerce_http_test only: commerce-postgresql-cache-before/result.json records a successful but skipped second Gradle invocation, unchanged XML and mutated quantity 777; the independent verifier correctly exited 1. After the fix, both invocations without --rerun-tasks generated fresh XML and verified quantity 1: commerce-postgresql-cache-after/result.json, exit 0. Prior shared 18-contract PostgreSQL checks used --rerun-tasks and remain distinct. App DB and preserved VOC reproduction data were untouched. Final project approval remains pending.

findings.description: The explicit demo override inherited two investigation worker slots while the profile example and proposed demo plan permit one concurrent model call. Concurrent investigations could hit the ledger concurrency rejection. This was a configuration finding, not an observed paid-provider failure.
findings.resolution: Set JDD_AGENT_WORKER_CONCURRENCY=1 only in agent-app/compose.openai-demo.yaml. Keep standard development Compose, model activation conditions and all ledger limits unchanged; do not edit the owner's in-progress queue expiry/claim implementation.
findings.verification: Rendered Compose configuration before/after: demo-worker-concurrency-before.json has worker=2/model=1; demo-worker-concurrency-after.json has worker=1/model=1 and verifies the standard Compose has neither this override nor paid activation. Used the expired example profile and a nonexistent key path; no app activation or model calls. Actual paid-model concurrency/quality remains part of the pending approved demo.

findings.description: VOC HTTP contracts did not track external PostgreSQL mode and could return UP-TO-DATE with unchanged XML after test database contents changed.
findings.resolution: Track only presence of VOC_TEST_DB_URL and disable up-to-date/build-cache reuse in that mode; preserve all assertions and H2 defaults. Only voc-app build settings and verification README changed.
findings.verification: Dedicated jdd_voc_contract_test: voc-postgresql-cache-before/result.json records the skipped repeat with CACHE_PROBE_CHANGED title and unchanged XML (verifier exit 1). Both fixed repetitions execute and restore the expected title in voc-postgresql-cache-after/result.json (exit 0). Current VOC HTTP contracts 7/7 passed on PostgreSQL with no skips in voc-blank-identifiers-postgresql-01. No application DB changes or paid model calls. Final approval remains pending.

findings.description: VOC-AGENT-EXPORT-001 reports that the ledger exporter cannot locate Docker Compose on native Windows with its restricted environment. It discarded Windows profile/installation variables and assumed docker compose exists.
findings.resolution: Preserve only required OS/profile/Docker environment names, probe the plugin then standalone Compose, and sanitize subprocess discovery/export failures. Keep the read-only SQL and no-model-call behavior. Await native Windows consumer verification and Agent owner acknowledgement. Agent owner acknowledgement and integration verification arrived in 54fe313; native Windows VOC acceptance is still pending.
findings.verification: Six regression tests pass for environment filtering, plugin/fallback selection and failure handling; failed attempts including the macOS temporary-path alias assertion remain in exporter-portability-{before,after,final} logs. Real macOS Docker/PostgreSQL export observes READ ONLY / REPEATABLE READ with zero ledger calls in exporter-portability-real-postgresql.json. No actual Windows execution or paid-model quality validation is claimed; finding remains OPEN.

findings.description: After DISC-agent-005 P1 agreement, intake still accepted all 16 concurrent new requests despite a configured capacity of three and returned 202 on a full queue.
findings.resolution: Add V8 singleton admission lock, READ COMMITTED transaction for key recheck/count/insert, capacity 20 bounded to 1..100, and 429 INVESTIGATION_QUEUE_FULL with Retry-After 5. Preserve existing IDs/conflicts and all stored investigations; add the agreed consumer behavior to the shared contract.
findings.verification: Before: QueueAdmissionTest 3/3 failed, preserved in queue-admission-before/result.xml. After: H2 admission/API/execution 24 passed; final PostgreSQL 17.6 HTTP/DB admission 4/4 passed without skips in queue-admission-postgresql-01. Sixteen distinct requests yield 3 accepted/13 rejected; sixteen same-key requests use one slot/ID. Conflict 409, invalid input 400, 1/100 boundaries, lower-capacity preservation and claim/expiry slot recovery pass; API/OAuth/budget rows remain zero. Agent owner and VOC worker/UI consumer acceptance remain pending; this is not final approval.
